Thereafter, the Respondent No.2 filed a Petition No. 289/MP/2018 against the Appellant No.1 under Section 79 (1) (b) and (f) of the Electricity Act, seeking payment of Capacity Charges and Transmission Charges as per the applicable provisions of the “Procurers PPA” read with “PTC PPA” dated 18.1.2014 and 20.1.2014 respectively. The Central Commission by its order dated 30.04.2019 disposed of the said Petition by holding that the amount deducted by the Appellant No.1 towards the capacity and Transmission Charges from the invoices of April and May 2017, ought to be refunded to the Respondent No. 2 along with the carrying cost/Late payment surcharge.
